theorems.name: Submission.fiw_ims_mass_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (V : Set (Eucl P)) (η : TestFormOn U k) (C : ℝ), 0 < C → tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ V → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ≤ C) → ENNReal.ofReal |X η| ≤ X.massOn V * ENNReal.ofReal C
